text: Datashift, a Mechelen data consultancy founded in 2015 by two co-founders and led by co-founder and CEO Nico Huybrechts, brought in private-equity player Finco as a strategic partner in 2024.
short: Datashift is co-founder-led with private-equity firm Finco as partner.

source.name: Made in Mechelen: Datashift schakelt versnelling hoger
source.quote: Om die groeiambities kracht bij te zetten, neemt het bedrijf Finco onder de arm, een private equityspeler.
source.note: Dutch; translation: 'To give force to those growth ambitions, the company brings Finco on board, a private-equity player.' Same article: the team initially consisted of 'de twee oprichters' (the two founders) and quotes 'Nico Huybrechts, medeoprichter en CEO van Datashift' (co-founder and CEO).
